headline: Three Fronts Shift as Weathered Expanse Bears Heaviest Fire
war_summary: The map has shifted since the last edition. Weathered Expanse, the war's heaviest furnace, now stands seven Colonial works against two unclaimed, where the previous count was five and four; its guns accounted for more than five thousand Colonial and eight thousand eight hundred Warden casualties in the past day, with a fresh event filed as this report went to press. Callahan's Passage, reported all-Warden at the last filing, has yielded one post to Colonial hands and remains noisy, with eight events in two hours and the latest at 8:37. The Nevish Line, quiet earlier, has stirred again: fifty events in the day have left five Warden works against three Colonial. Stlican Shelf holds seven Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed after sixteen events, and Stonecradle stands seven Colonial to two Warden. Palantine Berm's seven Warden posts remain after thirty-five events in the day, fourteen of them losses to the sitting owner. Mooring County's twelve Warden works still stand amid roughly four thousand nine hundred Colonial and four thousand five hundred Warden casualties. No victory has been declared.
